title: Geometry-induced pulse dynamics in a bulk-surface reaction-diffusion system for cell polarization
summary: This paper studies a bulk--surface reaction--diffusion system for cell polarization in two-dimensional domains. The model describes the formation of localized patterns through the wave-pinning mechanism, while explicitly incorporating the effect of cell shape. Using singular perturbation methods, we formally derive reduced ordinary differential equations describing the wave-pinning dynamics on a fast time scale and the subsequent slow drift of pulse solutions induced by domain geometry.
